competition.name: playground-series-s3e20
competition.description: Predict CO2 emissions in Rwanda using satellite data
competition.notes:
- Time series component: year (2019-2021 train, 2022 test), week_no (0-52)
- Geographic component: latitude, longitude in Rwanda
- 75 features mostly from satellite sensors (Cloud, Aerosol, UV measurements)
- Heavy missing values in some feature groups (99.4% in UvAerosolLayerHeight)
- Target is heavily right-skewed (median 45.6, mean 81.9, max 3167.8)
- Sample submission uses mean of training target as baseline

experiments.notes: Log1p target transformation, GPU training, time-based validation
Key: emission stable per (loc,week) across years; target encoding is the dominant signal. log1p target. Cannot submit (comp closed).

experiments.model: LGB+XGB+CatBoost blend + EB-shrunk loc-week target encoding
experiments.features: 70 base (63 sensors, dropped 7) + te_locweek(shrunk alpha=0.935) + te_loc
experiments.notes: Round 1 of Phase-B iteration. Cells are perfectly balanced panel (497 loc x 53 wk x 3yr) so every LOYO fold's source has exactly n=2 obs/cell -- shrinking the noisy 2-obs cell mean toward the ~106-obs loc mean improves OOF. GBDTs still expected to get ~0 weight (structure-dominant target, per s3e20/s3e19 boundary-condition insight in knowledge/experience.md).

experiments.model: LGB+XGB+CatBoost blend + EB-shrunk + COVID-downweighted loc-week target encoding
experiments.features: 70 base (63 sensors, dropped 7) + te_locweek(alpha=0.945, w2020=0.29) + te_loc
experiments.notes: Round 2 of Phase-B iteration. 2020 COVID dip makes that year's observations less representative of 'normal' location-week levels shared with 2019/2021/2022; down-weighting (not fully excluding -- W2020=0 was tested and worse than 0.29, still gives 2020 partial credit) improves OOF further. GBDTs still ~0 weight.

experiments.model: LGB+XGB+CatBoost blend + neighbor-week-smoothed + COVID-downweighted loc-week target encoding
experiments.features: 70 base (63 sensors, dropped 7) + te_locweek(alpha=1.0, w2020=0.24, wnb=0.28) + te_loc
experiments.notes: Round 3 of Phase-B iteration. Neighboring-week smoothing is a second, complementary way (local/seasonal vs Round-1's global loc-mean) to denoise the n=2-per-fold cell mean; re-tuned ALPHA collapses to 1.0, meaning Round-1 loc-mean shrinkage becomes redundant once neighbor-week smoothing is applied (both reduce the same source of noise). GBDTs still ~0 weight.

experiments.model: LGB residual model on (emission - TE_v5) [DIAGNOSTIC, REJECTED]
experiments.features: lat/lon/week + sin/cos + 63 sensors (median-imputed); target = residual vs v5 TE
experiments.notes: NEGATIVE RESULT (kept as documentation): no residual signal exists beyond the smoothed location-week structure -- sensor features are noise even for the residual. Confirms s3e20 boundary condition: when target is near-constant across years per (loc,week), structure fully saturates the predictable signal. Iteration stopped per protocol (wider window + residual model both non-improving).

experiments.model: tree-search v2 JOINT lineage: pure-structural location-week TE (EB shrinkage + COVID-downweight + neighbor smoothing + multi-year downweight, jointly re-optimized)
experiments.notes: Tree-search result (Phase E-4, harness v2, 2026-07-04) — NOT a linear-iteration round. Source: experiments_tree.json, node #28, the JOINT lineage's pure-structural optimum (38 evaluated nodes total: 37 solo/1 blend, 0 dedup rejections, 15 backtrack events, wall 33.3s total for the ENTIRE sweep; node #28 itself is a solo config, node wall_s=0.07s). This is a location-week historical-mean target-encoding pipeline (method=te) with 4 tuned scalar hyperparameters: alpha=0.99 (empirical-Bayes shrinkage), w2020=0.2 (COVID downweight), wnb=0.3 (neighbor-week smoothing weight), window=1, PLUS a new year_weights axis {2019: 0.6, 2020: 0.2, 2021: 1.2} (downweighting anomalous years 2019/2020, upweighting 2021 as closest to the test year) that Phase-B's one-axis-at-a-time protocol never tried. Beats the Phase-B hand-tuned root (experiment_id=7, 21.1487, root re-verified digit-for-digit before the search) by -0.0898 (~-0.42% relative). IMPORTANT — do NOT log the 21.0332 blend instead: node #28's sibling BLEND node (#29, not logged here) mixes this structural node with a diagnostic GBDT at only 2.17% weight, over just 3-fold Leave-One-Year-Out CV with the weight fitted directly on the same OOF it is scored on — STATUS.md explicitly calls this '低信心...視為 CV 噪音範圍內的邊際發現,非穩健結論' (low-confidence, within CV-noise margin, not a robust conclusion). Node #28 (21.0589, logged here) is the robust, purely-structural result: JOINT-moving all 4 tuned axes together in one step (plus the new year_weights axis) reached a composed optimum that Phase-B's one-axis-at-a-time manual tuning was structurally unable to find, even though re-scanning each individually-tuned axis (w2020, wnb) in isolation only confirmed Phase-B's existing optimum (an honest 'tie', not a gain). See competitions/playground-series-s3e20/STATUS.md Appendix 'Phase E-4 樹搜尋 v2' for the full node/lineage table and the honest regime-observation discussion. OOF-only search result — no test predictions were generated, so no submission field (do not fabricate a filename); not submitted to Kaggle.
